messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in AI, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

The knowledge base did not validate a complete answer. It returned partial RAW-supported evidence, but flagged missing `market_segment` evidence and missing `direct_relationship`, so the evidence is insufficient to make a fully validated “strongest opportunities” ranking across the whole AI market.

Based only on the retrieved RAW evidence, the strongest supported opportunities are:

| Rank | Opportunity | Why it looks strong | RAW evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **CMX500 AI-assisted test automation for mobile device testing** | This is the most directly AI-linked opportunity. The RAW evidence explicitly describes the **CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant** as an **AI-powered tool** for the **CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester**, intended to simplify and accelerate test engineers’ scripting process. | [27] `raw/Productions/PR/CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation.md` |
| 2 | **5G NR protocol testing, application testing, and instrument automation using CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant** | The same RAW evidence directly names domain-specific applications that can be automated: **R&D 5G NR protocol testing**, **application testing**, and **instrument automation**. This supports positioning CMX500 not just as a tester, but as an AI-enabled automation platform for mobile-device R&D workflows. | [27] |
| 3 | **CMX500 for Wi‑Fi 7 + cellular / non-cellular wireless-device R&D** | The evidence supports a broader multi-standard R&D opportunity. RAW says R&S demonstrated the **CMX500 multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester** with newly added **Wi‑Fi 7 testing capabilities**, allowing R&D engineers to test latest-generation **cellular and non-cellular standards** in a single setup. | [28] `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md` |
| 4 | **CMP180 for high-bandwidth non-signaling R&D and production testing beyond Wi‑Fi 7** | This is the strongest non-CMX opportunity found in the returned evidence. RAW says the **CMP180 radio communication tester** can verify a **480 MHz bandwidth** waveform in loopback mode and is a **future-proof solution** for R&D and production, even beyond Wi‑Fi 7 requirements. | [28] |

Important limitations from the vault result:

- The vault did **not** return validated market-segment evidence tying these tester opportunities specifically to broader **AI infrastructure, AI devices, or AI semiconductor** market demand.
- It did **not** provide option codes, pricing, licensing details, customer adoption data, ROI, or quantified productivity gains.
- The clearest AI-specific evidence is for **CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant**, not for AI market applications broadly.

So the safest conclusion is:

> The best vault-supported AI opportunity is **CMX500 AI-assisted scripting and test automation for mobile-device R&D**, followed by **CMX500 multi-standard Wi‑Fi 7/cellular R&D testing** and **CMP180 high-bandwidth non-signaling R&D/production testing**. Only the first is directly evidenced as AI-powered; the others are adjacent high-value wireless test opportunities, not fully validated as AI-market opportunities by the current vault evidence.

data.answer:
已查到可引用的部分資料：

建議主軸：目前 RAW 證據最強的是 CMX500 的 AI-assisted test automation，其次是 CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 / cellular + non-cellular R&D testing，第三是 CMP180 480 MHz waveform loopback for R&D and production [27][28]。
### 推薦先賣
CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant 是最強 AI 機會，因為 RAW 明示它是 AI-powered tool for the CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester，能簡化並加速 test engineers 的 scripting process [27]。
CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant 可切入 R&D 5G NR protocol testing、application testing 與 instrument automation，因為 RAW 明示這些是它可自動化的 domain-specific applications [27]。
CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 testing 是第二強機會，因為 RAW 明示 R&S 在 MWC 2024 展示 CMX500 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with newly added Wi‑Fi 7 testing capabilities [28]。
CMX500 可切入同時涵蓋 cellular and non-cellular standards 的 wireless-device R&D，因為 RAW 明示 one-box tester 讓 R&D engineers 在 single instrument setup 中 comprehensively test designs across both standards [28]。
CMP180 是 strongest RAW-supported non-CMX opportunity，因為 RAW 明示 CMP180 radio communication tester will verify a signal waveform of 480 MHz bandwidth in loopback mode [28]。
CMP180 可切入 R&D and production with headroom beyond Wi‑Fi 7，因為 RAW 明示它是 future-proof solution for users in R&D and production, even beyond Wi‑Fi 7 requirements [28]。
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CMX500 | AI-assisted scripting and test automation | CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant | RAW 直接把 AI-powered tool 連到 CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester，並說它簡化與加速 script generation。[27] | AI-powered tool、CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester、script generation from diverse sources。[27] | RAW 未提供 option code、價格、授權型號或交付條件。[27] |
| CMX500 | R&D 5G NR protocol testing、application testing、instrument automation | 知識庫未標示 option code | RAW 直接列出這些 domain-specific applications 可由 assistant 自動化。[27] | R&D 5G NR protocol testing、application testing、instrument automation。[27] | RAW 未提供可量化效率提升、客戶案例或導入數據。[27] |
| CMX500 | Wi‑Fi 7 plus cellular / non-cellular wireless-device R&D | Newly added Wi‑Fi 7 testing capabilities | RAW 明示 CMX500 可在 single instrument setup 中測試 latest-generation cellular and non-cellular standards。[28] | Multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester、Wi‑Fi 7 testing capabilities、single instrument setup。[28] | RAW 未提供 Wi‑Fi 7 option code、test cases、頻寬或 production throughput。[28] |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile-device R&D test automation | CMX500 + CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant | 以 AI-powered scripting assistant 降低 script generation complexity，切入 5G NR protocol、application testing 與 instrument automation。[27] | RAW 未提供 ROI、節省工時百分比或客戶採用狀態。[27] |
| Wi‑Fi 7 / multi-standard wireless R&D | CMX500 | 以 one-box tester 的 cellular and non-cellular single setup 測試能力切入 wireless-device design validation。[28] | RAW 未提供 Wi‑Fi 7 測項清單、option code 或量產測試節拍。[28] |
